title: pESTO: Iterative p-greedy kernel regression with risk-driven Early STOpping
abstract: arXiv:2611.08555v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Kernel-based greedy algorithms select suitable approximation nodes by minimizing point-wise error indicators, such as the power function; in this context, they are usually referred to as p-greedy approaches. In the presence of noisy data, deterministic criteria may fail, as the discrepancy between the true solution and its estimate is influenced by both approximation error and noise amplification, and the balance between the two is unknown. This study explicitly separates these two contributions, which are governed by the power function and a Lebesgue-type term, respectively. These bounds motivate the use of the Stein's unbiased risk estimator (SURE) as a proxy of the mean squared error, which in turn provides a principled and computable stopping criterion for the number of nodes to select in the p-greedy procedure. translated_title: pESTO：基于风险驱动早停的迭代p-贪婪核回归
translated_abstract: 基于核的贪婪算法通过最小化逐点误差指标（如幂函数）来选择合适的逼近节点；在此背景下，它们通常被称为p-贪婪方法。在存在噪声数据的情况下，确定性准则可能失效，因为真实解与其估计值之间的偏差同时受到逼近误差和噪声放大两者的影响，而二者之间的平衡是未知的。本研究显式地分离了这两个贡献项，它们分别由幂函数和一个Lebesgue型项所控制。这些界启发了使用Stein无偏风险估计（SURE）作为均方误差的代理，进而为p-贪婪过程中应选择的节点数量提供了一个有原则且可计算的停止准则。数值实验表明，该方法能够有效地平衡确定性精度与统计噪声控制。
tldr: 该论文提出pESTO方法，通过显式分离逼近误差与噪声放大，并采用Stein无偏风险估计（SURE）作为均方误差的代理，为p-贪婪核回归中节点数量的选择提供了一个有原则且可计算的早停准则。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes pESTO, which explicitly separates approximation error from noise amplification and employs Stein's unbiased risk estimator (SURE) as a proxy for the mean squared error, providing a principled and computable early stopping criterion for node selection in p-greedy kernel regression.
